stories.title: Create BEV C02 Performance Assessment with Component Failure Diagnosis Rubrics
stories.description: Develop Performance Assessment (PA) for BEV C02 (Electrical Systems) focusing on BMS/HV cable/OBC component identification, fault diagnosis, and testing competency with evaluator rubrics aligned to NOSS assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md includes rubric with 4 competency levels for diagnosing 8 critical BMS/electrical component faults (pass threshold ≥70%)
Three practical fault diagnosis scenarios provided with expected troubleshooting procedure and safety checklist per scenario
Assessment linked to C02 KA and KP content with evaluator answer key including partial credit guidance
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C02/PA.md (sections: TAJUK, TUJUAN, PENERANGAN, LANGKAH KERJA, SENARAI SEMAK, RUBRIK PENILAIAN)

Cross-reference: Validate PA.md references all 8 components from C02/KP-01.md and C02/KP-02.md

stories.title: Create BEV C03 Performance Assessment with Thermal Load Calculation and Diagnosis Competency
stories.description: Develop PA for BEV C03 (Thermal Systems) with hands-on thermal load measurement, coolant system diagnosis, and heat dissipation testing aligned to NOSS CoCU assessment criteria and safety procedures.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md includes 4 practical tasks: temperature sensor calibration, coolant flow rate measurement, heat exchanger efficiency test, thermal failure diagnosis scenario
Competency rubric with 5 levels (Novice→Expert) for thermal load calculation accuracy (±5°C tolerance threshold)
Integrated safety checklist for coolant handling (spill procedures, electrical isolation, PPE requirements) with pass/fail criteria
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C03/PA.md (include tables for temperature ranges, coolant specs, diagnostic decision tree)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validate_technical_depth.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/C03/PA.md --topic thermal-systems --min-tasks 4
Safety validation: Script confirms all hazardous procedures cross-reference C03/KP-02.md (Thermal System Safety)

stories.title: Create BEV C04 Performance Assessment with Motor Efficiency Testing and Controller Diagnostics
stories.description: Develop PA for BEV C04 (Electric Drive Train) covering motor efficiency measurement, controller fault diagnosis with 5+ test scenarios, and drive system performance validation with NOSS-aligned rubrics.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md includes motor efficiency testing procedure with pass/fail thresholds (>85% efficiency baseline) and measurement method checklist
Five fault diagnosis scenarios provided: motor winding fault, controller overtemp, inverter failure, torque sensor error, CAN bus communication loss
Evaluator rubric with 4 competency levels covering fault isolation methodology, testing equipment operation, and safety during high-voltage testing
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/PA.md (include diagnostic flowchart table and test equipment list)

stories.title: Build BEV Lesson Plans (PM-teori and PM-amali) for C01-C02 with Safety-First Pedagogical Integration
stories.description: Create four lesson plan documents (C01 theory, C01 practical, C02 theory, C02 practical) following 4-phase WIM structure (Pengenalan, Penerangan, Praktik, Penilaian) with hazard identification integrated into every lesson phase.
acceptanceCriteria: Each PM file contains all 4 phases with learning outcomes (4-5 per phase) linked to corresponding KP, KT, KK documents using document code references (e.g., 'G452-010-3:2023-C01/KP(1/2)')
Safety hazard matrix embedded in Penerangan phase: 5-8 electrical/HV hazards per CU with mitigation steps and PPE requirements
Time allocation specified: 30% theory (KP+KT), 70% practical (KK) with milestone assessment checkpoints aligned to KA/PA

stories.title: Develop IT Level 3 Knowledge Points (KP) for System Installation, Configuration, and Troubleshooting Procedures
stories.description: Create three KP documents for IT L3 covering system installation (Windows/Linux), OS configuration, and troubleshooting with step-by-step procedures, technical accuracy, and dual-OS examples throughout.
acceptanceCriteria: KP-01 (Installation): Covers Windows and Linux installation media creation, partitioning, bootloader setup, driver installation with screenshot examples and validation checkpoints (5-6 per section)
KP-02 (Configuration): Covers user management, file permissions, network settings, service configuration with command examples for both OS (10-12 config tasks)
KP-03 (Troubleshooting): Common issues taxonomy (boot failure, driver problems, network issues) with diagnostic decision trees and resolution steps (8-10 scenarios)
technicalNotes: Files to create: it-computer-system/L3/KP-01-installation.md, it-computer-system/L3/KP-02-configuration.md, it-computer-system/L3/KP-03-troubleshooting.md
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_it_l3_kp_technical.py::test_dual_os_coverage -v (validates Windows + Linux examples in each KP)
Accuracy: Technical procedures must be tested in lab environment and documented in _reference/it-l3-lab-validation.md before commit

stories.title: Create IT Level 3 Assignment Sheets (KT) with Scenario-Based Questions and Solution Guides
stories.description: Develop three KT documents for IT L3 with scenario-based questions (not MCQ-heavy), Bloom's taxonomy progression, detailed solution guides for evaluators, and cross-references to KP content.
acceptanceCriteria: Each KT contains 15-20 questions across 3 Bloom's levels: 40% recall/understand, 40% apply, 20% analyze/evaluate with 70% scenario-based format and 30% short-answer
Answer scheme provided: model answers (5-8 points each question), marking rubric with partial credit guidance, commonly expected variation acceptance criteria
Cross-reference explicit: Each question cites KP section (e.g., 'KP-01-installation::Bootloader Setup') and expected CU competency (G/E/S level)
technicalNotes: Files to create: it-computer-system/L3/KT-01.md, it-computer-system/L3/KT-02.md, it-computer-system/L3/KT-03.md (with embedded answer schemes)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validate_assessment_structure.py it-computer-system/L3/KT-*.md --bloom-levels 3 --scenario-ratio 0.7
Consistency: Question language and technical terms must match KP-*.md terminology (use _reference/it-l3-glossary.md as canonical)

stories.title: Create IT Level 3 Worksheets (KK) with Step-by-Step Linux/Windows Command Sequences and Validation Tasks
stories.description: Develop three KK documents for IT L3 with hands-on lab tasks, full command sequences, pre/post-task validation steps, and bilingual instruction where applicable (EN commands + BM procedure descriptions).
acceptanceCriteria: Each KK contains 4-6 hands-on tasks with complete command sequences: Windows PowerShell + Linux bash commands side-by-side, parameter explanations, expected output screenshots
Task validation: Pre-task checks (environment setup), post-task verification commands (confirm task success), success criteria documented (e.g., 'service status running', 'port listening')
Bilingual integration: Command syntax in English, procedure instructions in EN/BM (e.g., 'Open terminal' / 'Buka terminal', 'Run the command' / 'Jalankan perintah')
technicalNotes: Files to create: it-computer-system/L3/KK-01-windows-admin.md, it-computer-system/L3/KK-02-linux-fundamentals.md, it-computer-system/L3/KK-03-network-basics.md
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_it_l3_kk_procedures.py::test_command_syntax_valid -v (validates command syntax against bash/PowerShell parsers)
Lab environment: All procedures tested on clean Windows 11 + Ubuntu 22.04 VMs; test results documented in _reference/it-l3-lab-results.md

stories.title: Create IT Level 4 Knowledge Assessment (KA) with Network Administration and Security Competency Focus
stories.description: Develop comprehensive KA document for IT L4 covering network services (DNS, DHCP, routing), firewall rules, VPN configuration, and security hardening with 25+ questions, mix of formats, and evaluator rubrics.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md contains 25+ questions: 10 MCQ (40%), 8 short-answer scenario (40%), 7 case-study analysis (20%) covering DNS/DHCP/routing/firewall/VPN/security topics
Answer scheme with rubric: Full answers (8-10 pts), partial answers (4-7 pts), incorrect (0 pts) with common acceptable variations documented for evaluator consistency
Scenario authenticity: Real-world network scenarios (small office LAN design, remote access security, incident response) aligned to IT L4 CoCU competencies
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/L4/KA.md (structure: TAJUK, TUJUAN, PENERANGAN, SOALAN 1-25, SKIM JAWAPAN)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validate_assessment_coverage.py it-computer-system/L4/KA.md --required-topics DNS,DHCP,firewall,VPN,security --min-questions 25
Validation: All question scenarios must cite L4 KP topics and match complexity level from NOSS IT-020-4 CoCU

stories.title: Create IT Level 5 Knowledge Assessment (KA) with Enterprise IT Management and Strategic Decision-Making
stories.description: Develop KA document for IT L5 emphasizing strategic IT management, team leadership, project planning, and organizational decision-making with case-study format and evaluator rubrics for subjective scoring.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md contains 10-15 case-study questions simulating real IT manager roles: enterprise architecture decisions, team performance issues, budget allocation, security policy creation, vendor selection
Scoring rubric with 4 competency levels (Novice/Competent/Proficient/Expert) for each case, evaluating decision-making rationale, stakeholder consideration, and business alignment
Complexity: Open-ended answers expected; rubric guides evaluators on acceptable solution variations and decision quality indicators
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/L5/KA.md (structure: TAJUK, TUJUAN, PENERANGAN, KES-KAJIAN 1-10/15, RUBRIK PENILAIAN)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validate_leadership_assessment.py it-computer-system/L5/KA.md --case-studies 10-15 --rubric-levels 4
Content validation: Case studies must reflect NOSS IT-020-5 CoCU competencies (leadership, strategic planning, organizational effectiveness)

stories.title: Build Automated Competency-to-Assessment Cross-Reference Matrix with Coverage Validation Tool
stories.description: Develop JSON-based competency matrix and Python validator mapping each NOSS CoCU work activity and related knowledge to corresponding WIM documents (KP/KT/KK/KA/PA), with CLI report generation for coverage gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage matrix (_data/coverage_matrix.json): Maps all NOSS work activities to KK files, all related knowledge items to KP files, all assessments to KA/PA files with document code references
Python validator script (_tools/coverage_validator.py): Scans all subject folders, detects missing document mappings, generates gap report with 'Not Covered' list per subject
CLI interface: `uv run python _tools/coverage_validator.py --subject BEV --output report.txt` produces gap analysis; `--subject all` scans all three subjects
technicalNotes: Files to create: _data/coverage_matrix.json (JSON structure: subject → CU → {work_activities: [{noss_code, kk_file, status}], related_knowledge: [{noss_code, kp_file, status}], assessments: [{type, file, status}]}), _tools/coverage_validator.py
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_coverage_validator.py::test_no_unmapped_activities -v (ensures zero gap coverage)
Integration: Run validator in CI/CD pipeline on every commit to prevent undocumented work activities; report output used for sprint planning
